title: AI Techlead
description:
At a glance
Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users.
We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. As an
AI Tech Lead
, you set the technical direction across these initiatives and stay close enough to the code to keep that pace honest. If you've got 7+ years of engineering experience, a serious track record of shipping AI in production, and you're looking to lead at a scale most companies won't give you for years, read on.
Your job
You set the technical direction on GenAI initiatives that span the bank: from the first conversation with a business team through to production and beyond. You decide how things get built, you build with the team, and you make sure the right things actually get done in a complex organisation. Your focus shifts with the use case: backend, frontend, from leveraging LLM’s to agentic. You own outcomes, not just architecture diagrams. You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving, and you bring the rest of the team along.
Concretely, you'll:
Set the technical direction for GenAI solutions across banking use cases: Voice AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, document intelligence.
Drive initiatives end-to-end through a complex organisation: align stakeholders, unblock teams, make the calls that need to be made.
Co-create use cases with business counterparts: you understand the problem, not just the technology, and you shape what gets built.
Stay hands-on: design and write the hard parts if required.
Own architecture and technical quality across multiple workstreams: trade-offs, patterns, what we standardise on, what we don't.
Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tool is for the job.
Raise the technical bar of the team: code reviews, design reviews, knowledge sharing, coaching mediors and juniors.
Working environment
You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals: fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Amsterdam, hybrid.
Your profile
We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped and what you've led. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra — what they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building over theorising. As a tech lead, you bring the same plus the ability to take an ambiguous problem and a group of strong engineers and turn it into something running in production.
What you've done:
Led the technical side of AI or software initiatives end-to-end: you've owned the architecture, made the hard calls, and shipped.
Built and deployed AI applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, voice AI, or equivalent (at production scale, with real users).
Written Python that runs in production: you're a developer, not a notebook user, and you still enjoy writing the code.
Worked with cloud infrastructure: Azure preferred, AWS or GCP also fine.
Operated inside a complex organisation (or built the muscle elsewhere) and got things done across teams, not just within one.
How you work:
You take ambiguous problems, set a direction, and bring people with you (without waiting for permission).
You have strong technical opinions, formed through experience, and you're willing to defend them and change them.
You're as interested in the business problem as in the technical solution.
You explain your decisions clearly to people who don't share your context (engineers, business, leadership).
You follow the GenAI field closely because you're genuinely curious, not because you have to.
You've built something on the side (a tool, a project, a contribution) that shows you don't wait to be told what to learn.
We are offering
We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer:
An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget which adds up to a range of €65.000 to €93.000 a year based on a 36-hour week (40 hours possible, pro-rated)
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.
You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.
Interested?
No motivation letter. Please answer these two questions instead:
Tell us about an AI initiative you led: what did you build, what calls did you make as the technical lead, and what did you learn when it hit production (or real users)?
What's the most interesting thing you've built or experimented with in AI in the last six months? Why does it matter to you?
Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.
The recruitmentprocess consists of an online personality assessment, an online culture interview, a technical case and an offline technical Interview.
Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable
At ABN AMRO, we believe in "
Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of
being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.
If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

title: Applied Data Scientist - Intelligent Document Processing
description:
In het kort
Heb jij een Data Science-achtergrond, maar haal je minstens zoveel energie uit het begrijpen van een probleem als uit het schrijven van code? Wil jij echte impact maken en begrijp je dat een AI-systeem groter is dan alleen een model? Spreek jij de taal van zowel business stakeholders als IT? Lees dan verder!
Binnen het Doc2Data-programma werk je samen met business stakeholders om document-intensieve hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller, en betrouwbaarder te maken voor onze klanten en medewerkers. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen die documenten classificeren en informatie extraheren om beschikbaar te maken voor onze processen. Hiervoor gebruik je bestaande componenten, maar denk je ook mee over lange termijn behoeftes en het verbeteren van het raamwerk.
Ben jij inhoudelijk sterk én comfortabel in een complex stakeholderveld? Dan is het AI team van Home Financing de plek voor jou!
Je werk
Als Data Scientist binnen het Doc2Data-programma draag je bij aan het verbeteren en opschalen van Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) binnen hypotheekprocessen. Je werkt aan toepassingen voor documentclassificatie, data-extractie, handmatige validatie en monitoring. Binnen het Doc2Data programma bouw je doorgaans geen complexe machine-learningmodellen vanaf nul. De uitdaging zit vooral in het begrijpen van documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes, en in het vertalen daarvan naar werkende AI-oplossingen met aantoonbare impact.
In deze rol ben je van begin tot eind betrokken:
Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete IDP-oplossingen die hypotheekprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder maken.
Je verdiept je in documenten, processen en gebruikersbehoeftes en bepaalt welke informatie herkend, geëxtraheerd of gevalideerd moet worden.
Je ontwerpt oplossingen met bestaande AI-componenten en stuurt daarbij op impact en praktische toepasbaarheid, niet op modelcomplexiteit.
Je definieert en verbetert trainingsdata, beoordeelt extractiekwaliteit en helpt oplossingen stap voor stap beter te maken.
Je onderbouwt keuzes met analyses, experimenten en prototypes en vertaalt inzichten naar een vorm die past bij de ontvanger, zoals een advies aan een proceseigenaar of een user story voor een IT-implementatieteam.
Je werkt nauw samen met IT-teams, proceseigenaren, business analisten en domeinexperts in een complex stakeholderveld.
Je denkt actief mee over implementatie, monitoring, beheer en doorontwikkeling, zodat AI-oplossingen robuust onderdeel worden van end-to-end processen.
Werkomgeving
Het Center of Expertise Advanced Analytics & AI is onderdeel van de afdeling CDTO (Data & Technology) binnen Home Financing van ABN AMRO. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor data science- en complexe analytics-initiatieven binnen Home Financing.
Je komt terecht in een team met een mix van startende en ervaren Data Scientists. Wij vinden het binnen het team belangrijk om kennis te delen, van elkaar te leren en het gezellig te hebben met elkaar. Dit zal je in de praktijk continu ervaren!
In je dagelijkse werkzaamheden voor het Doc2Data programma werk je intensief samen met collega’s van onder andere IT, businessteams en Operational Excellence (OPEX), die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het initiëren en realiseren van procesverbeteringen. Binnen deze multidisciplinaire samenwerking worden data‑ en AI‑oplossingen ontwikkeld die direct bijdragen aan het verbeteren van processen en klantbediening.
Je profiel
Je bent een hands-on Data Scientist die energie krijgt van analyseren, verbeteren en samenwerken.
Je vindt het leuk om toegewijd op een inhoudelijk domein te werken en daarin echt meters te maken.
Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en voelt eigenaarschap voor de kwaliteit en impact van je oplossingen.
Een academisch werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur een kwantitatieve opleiding).
3-6 jaar professionele werkervaring in Advanced Analytics / Data Science / Machine Learning.
Kennis van Python en SQL.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Affiniteit met het werken in een omgeving waar je nauw samenwerkt met business stakeholders en engineers.
Wij bieden
De uitdaging om het beste uit jezelf te halen! Je hebt de mogelijkheid om flexibel te werken, krijgt direct verantwoordelijkheid en wij geven je de ruimte om te groeien in een leuk, enthousiast en ambitieus team. Wij garanderen je dat dit een team is waar je veel van kan leren!
Daarnaast bieden wij:
Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36‑urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget. De vacature staat uit in Schaal 9, maar inschaling in Schaal 10 is mogelijk op basis van skills en ervaring.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar, dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privé gebruik.
Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze CAO die van toepassing is op deze vacature.
Interesse?
Ben je geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan nu online op deze vacature. Voor meer informatie kan je altijd contact opnemen met Tim Claessens (Data Scientist CoE AA&AI Home Financing) op +31 6 39582244 of tim.claessens@nl.abnamro.com. We maken graag kennis met je.
Proficiency of the Dutch language is required.

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "
Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als
persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd
sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

Product Strategy:

led partnerships across SWE, MLE, Product, Operations, and Compliance to align technical direction, drive clarity through ambiguity, and balance immediate product needs with long-term platform investments.

title: Scientist Innovator Collaborative Mission Autonomy
description:
About this position
The world of autonomous systems is evolving at a rapid pace. This technological progress is transforming not only the systems themselves, but also the way civilian and military operations are designed and conducted. We are witnessing a growing deployment of advanced autonomous platforms that are capable of collaborating with one another and carrying out complex tasks in a coordinated manner. Examples include cooperating airborne and maritime platforms that can operate fully autonomously in defence missions. These developments create new opportunities for more effective operations, faster decision-making, and enhanced situational awareness across a wide range of operational domains.
Within TNO’s Collaborative Autonomous Systems (CAS) department in The Hague, we develop innovative concepts, algorithms, and software for the reliable, optimal, robust, and effective deployment of heterogeneous teams of collaborating autonomous systems in complex operational environments. With a multidisciplinary team of more than thirty scientists and engineers, CAS combines research with practical, operationally relevant solutions, taking innovations from concept and prototype through to fully operational systems.
These systems are used, for example, in reconnaissance missions, surveillance operations, and logistical support, where environmental awareness, reliable navigation (including in GPS-denied or GPS-limited environments), and tactical effectiveness are essential. The mission autonomy technology we develop focuses on collaboration between teams of autonomous systems, improving environmental awareness, and enabling seamless interaction with military personnel and security teams so they can operate safely and effectively. Through close collaboration with other TNO departments, the Ministry of Defence, industry partners, research institutes, and universities, our innovations quickly find their way into practical applications.
To support this technological innovation, we are looking for a colleague who wants to contribute to the development of mission autonomy in a military context, helping Defence operate more safely, more rapidly, and more effectively.
What will be your role?
You will work on the development of mission autonomy in multidisciplinary, technically challenging projects for a variety of clients within the defence and security domain. In one project, you may investigate the feasibility of a concept or perform an in-depth system analysis; in the next, you may develop a practical, functional, and operationally relevant demonstrator. Depending on your expertise, interests, and the needs of the projects, your work may include:
Proofs of Concept: You translate academic insights into concrete, practical solutions. You do this by conducting literature reviews and system analyses, thereby actively contributing to new research. You develop concepts into software prototypes that enable decision support and autonomous behaviour, working closely with colleagues and stakeholders.
Algorithm Development: You translate complex customer challenges within the defence domain into technical requirements and functional concepts. You design and implement innovative algorithms for autonomous decision-making, planning, and situational awareness. These algorithms enable heterogeneous autonomous systems to make the right decisions in real time and collaborate effectively both with one another and with human operators. You further develop these solutions into prototypes and demonstrators.
System Integration: You integrate modules into complete systems across multiple disciplines. You collaborate with specialists, domain experts, and systems engineers to create an integrated, robust, and effective system. You test solutions in simulations and operationally relevant environments and incorporate feedback to deliver a robust and deployable end product.
Knowledge Sharing and Technical Leadership: You present results to clients, publish findings where possible, actively contribute to knowledge sharing among colleagues, and help shape the strategy and vision for these technological developments.
What we expect from you
We are looking for a team-oriented Scientist who thrives on collaboration, taking ownership, and developing innovative operational solutions. Within our team, communication is essential: you are confident in asking questions, proactively sharing progress, and raising concerns when you encounter challenges. We are seeking someone who is reliable, eager to learn, technically strong, and a supportive colleague.
You can seamlessly bridge scientific and conceptual thinking with practical implementation. You are a strong listener, capable of clarifying customer needs and translating complex requirements into executable solutions. You are a systems thinker who can, together with colleagues, develop system concepts, design and implement software, and contribute to the development of innovative technologies. In addition, you contribute to writing project proposals and can communicate complex topics clearly to a variety of audiences.

Excellent commandment of both Dutch and English verbally and in writing (C1 level).
